nativeArtifact.description: Installed official Rapier compatibility ESM including inlined WASM; dependency artifact identity, not owned application source.

instrumentedCopyDerivation.derivation: Only relative import relocation, fifth trusted observer argument, start clock immediately before finalPhysicalInput setup, and end clock/callback immediately after availability transform. No calculation/clone/guard removed. This is an instrumented copy, not unchanged production execution.

backend: Real Rapier, unpaced Node CPU; no browser/GPU/FPS measurement
workload: Same manyContacts70 inputs and flat surface; actual unified AUTO controller at 60Hz with fresh targets at 10Hz
observerComparison: Native observer ON in BOTH arms, same current instrumented copy. Five stage-observerOFF/ON pairs, alternating order. OFF performs observer guard only; ON adds two clocks and bounded per-car record writer. Whole-tick/wall differences quantify instrumentation plus host variance, not exact observer overhead or acceptance.
ownership: 10 sequential worlds disposed and native read rejected; this is not a 20-cycle lifecycle test.
scope: Diagnostic of NEW post027 finalTransform calculation/clones only. Original chronological v5FAIL5/5 remains unchanged. Not acceptance CPU, baseline replacement, allocation-byte attribution or hardware/FPS. No inspector profiler or forcedGC.

runs.stageWindowScope: From finalPhysicalInput setup through availability magnitude/signed-input/projection calculation and clones; excludes observer callback but includes observer clocks and shared guard. Not pure allocation time; instrumented copy only.
runs.incrementalScope: External whole-controller elapsed minus wrapped physical-port elapsed; includes admission, arbitration, realization, actuation dispatch, descriptor validation and two extra clocks. Packet preparation and semantic assertions occur outside sampled controller timing. Elapsed wall total includes them and remains diagnostic. Not a separately isolated algorithm timer.
